name: +verde
description: App de mapeamento de áreas não verdes e conexão com ONGs de reflorestamento

scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 5000)" && cd backend && npm run docker:migrate && npm run docker:seed
scripts.db:shell: docker compose exec db mysql -uroot -proot dbDadosVerde
scripts.migrate: docker compose exec backend npm run migrate
scripts.seed: docker compose exec backend npm run seed
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d && node -e "setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 5000)" && cd backend && npm run docker:migrate && npm run docker:seed
